grammar_focus: give 短语(give up / give in / give away)、say 与 tell 的区别、do 与 make 的搭配、be supposed to(应该/据说)、used to do(过去习惯)与过去进行、过去完成时的被动(work had been done)(原创承载 NCE3 L30 考点·净化换情节:去掉'战时开小差/被当局追捕'的外壳,改为埃里克年轻时与家人争吵后出走、被误以为已故,秘密归家隐居;鬼屋悬念与隐士承载原样保留·无违法元素)
scene: 多年来,村里人一直相信恩德利农场闹鬼。农场归乔和鲍勃·考克斯两兄弟所有,他们雇了几个工人,可谁都不肯久留。每个工人辞工时,讲的都是同一个故事:他们总是一觉醒来,发现活儿一夜之间就干完了。趁大家睡觉的时候,干草已被割好,牛棚也已打扫干净。有个熬了一整夜的工人声称,他看见月光下有个身影在割庄稼。渐渐地,一个说法被大家接受了:考克斯兄弟有一个尽职尽责的幽灵替他们干了大部分的活。谁也没料到,农场上还有一个从没露过面的人。可事实正是如此。不久前,村民们惊讶地得知,恩德利的幽灵去世了。人人都去参加了葬礼,因为那个“幽灵”不是别人,正是埃里克·考克斯——据说早在年轻时就去世的第三个兄弟。葬礼过后,乔和鲍勃说出了一个保守了五十多年的秘密。埃里克本是家中长子。年轻时,他和家人大吵一架,负气出海远走,多年来大家都以为他已经不在人世。其实他早已悄悄回了家,只是太要强、太羞愧,不愿再面对村里人。父亲把他藏了起来,对外只说埃里克已经死了。父亲去世后,乔和鲍勃觉得替他保守秘密是自己的责任。这么多年,埃里克一直像隐士一样生活。他过去总是白天睡觉、夜里干活,浑然不知自己已成了恩德利的幽灵。可当他去世时,两个兄弟发现,这个秘密再也瞒不下去了。

grammar_card.title: give up / say vs tell / do vs make / be supposed to / used to do
grammar_card.intro: ①give 短语:give up(放弃)、give in(屈服)、give away(赠送/泄露)。②say 与 tell:tell a lie / tell the time / tell a story;say goodbye / say so。③do 与 make:do the work / do sb a favor / do one's best;make a mistake / make a speech。④be supposed to “(按规矩)应该”或“据说、被认为”。⑤used to do 表示过去的习惯;某时刻“正在做”用过去进行(was/were doing)。⑥过去完成时的被动:had been + 过去分词,如 the work had been done。

rows: give up / give in / give away
放弃 / 屈服 / 赠送
do a favor / make a mistake
be supposed to / used to do
he used to work at night

specialRules.rule: tell 常接 a lie / a story / the time / the truth;say 常接 goodbye / so / 一句话。别把 say 和 tell 混用。
used to do 是过去的习惯(现在不再);was/were doing 是过去某一刻正在进行。两者不同。
美式:laborer(英式 labourer,少个 u)、corn(美语常指玉米,英式泛指谷物、玉米叫 maize)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Who was the ghost of Endley Farm?
options: A third brother who had been hidden for years

passage: For years, the people of the village believed that Endley Farm was haunted. The farm was owned by two brothers, Joe and Bob Cox, who hired a few laborers, but no one was willing to stay for long. Every time a worker gave up his job, he told the same story. The farmhands said that they always woke up to find that the work had been done overnight. Hay had been cut and the cowsheds had been cleaned while everyone slept. One worker, who stayed up all night, claimed to have seen a figure cutting corn in the moonlight. In time, it became an accepted fact that the Cox brothers were served by a conscientious ghost that did most of their work for them. No one suspected that there might be someone else on the farm who had never been seen. Yet that was exactly the case. A short time ago, the villagers were astonished to learn that the ghost of Endley had died. Everyone went to the funeral, for the 'ghost' was none other than Eric Cox, a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man. After the funeral, Joe and Bob revealed a secret that they had kept for over fifty years. Eric had been the eldest son of the family. As a young man he had quarreled bitterly with his relatives and had run off to sea, and for years everyone believed he had been lost. In truth he had come home in secret, too proud and too ashamed to face the village again. His father hid him and told everybody that Eric had died. When their father passed away, Joe and Bob thought it their duty to keep Eric in hiding. All these years, Eric had lived as a recluse. He used to sleep during the day and work at night, quite unaware that he had become the ghost of Endley. When he died, however, his brothers found it impossible to keep the secret any longer.

stage5.stem_cn: 每个工人都讲同样的鬼故事。

"Eric was ___ to have died as a young man."("据说、被认为"用 be ___ to)

"Eric ___ sleep during the day and work at night."(过去"习惯性地做"用 ___ do)

stage5.stem: "He ___ working in the fields when the worker saw him."(某时刻"正在做"用过去进行)

stage5.stem: "There ___ to be an old barn here years ago."(过去"曾经存在"用 ___ to be)
